settings.headline: Returns & Refunds
settings.image_alt: Senseless range on a warm off-white background

settings.headline: Returns policy
settings.body: You have 30 days from receipt to request a return. Items must be unused, unopened, and in original packaging; proof of purchase required. Items sent back without a prior return request are not accepted.

settings.headline: How it works
settings.body:
• Step 1 — Request: contact cs@senseless.uk with your order number; we confirm eligibility.
  • Step 2 — Return: once approved, we send instructions. Returns to: Paddock Business Centre, Paddock Road, Skelmersdale, WN8 9PL.
  • Step 3 — Refund: after we receive and inspect, refund to your original payment method within 10 working days.

settings.headline: Damaged or incorrect items
settings.body: Inspect on arrival. If anything is defective, damaged, or incorrect, contact cs@senseless.uk immediately — handled separately from standard returns, don't wait for the window to pass.

settings.headline: What cannot be returned
settings.body: Opened or used products are not eligible (hygiene). Sale items and gift cards are non-returnable. If unsure, ask before sending.

settings.question: Can I exchange instead?
settings.answer: No direct exchanges — return the original and place a new order.

settings.question: Who pays return postage?
settings.answer: The customer, unless the item arrived damaged, defective, or incorrect.

settings.question: How long for a refund?
settings.answer: Within 10 working days of receipt; your bank may take longer to post it. Over 15 working days since approval — contact cs@senseless.uk.

settings.question: Do you ship to the EU?
settings.answer: UK only at present; if that changes, EU customers get the additional 14-day cooling-off period.
